title_en: Beautiful Places in China (5/20): The Potala Palace, Sacred Hall of the Land of Snows
note_en: 对…来说 means "for..." or "as far as... is concerned" and sets up whose point of view the rest of the sentence takes: 对藏族人来说，布达拉宫不仅是一座建筑 "For Tibetans, the Potala Palace is not just a building." The person goes between 对 and 来说, and the whole frame comes before the main clause, much like an English opening "For Tibetans,..." The same pattern appears in 对小舟来说 and 对于一座…建筑来说.
